title_zh: 向调查人员说明亲眼所见并约定补充材料

scenario.label_zh: 记录骑行事件的证人信息
scenario.goal_zh: 区分证人亲眼所见与不确定部分，并约定通过已提供的正式渠道补充原始照片

context_zh: 一名目击者在警局向负责调查骑行碰撞事件的警官提供信息。
author: author-phase08-a

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Are you the inspector handling yesterday's cycling incident?

sentences.speaker: Inspector Bell
sentences.text: Yes. Did you see the collision itself?

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: No. I arrived just afterwards. I saw a helmet beside the bicycle and a car stopped further along.

sentences.speaker: Inspector Bell
sentences.text: That's useful to know. Please don't guess about anything you didn't see.

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: I took a photograph of the blocked road. Could that help the investigation?

sentences.speaker: Inspector Bell
sentences.text: It may. Here's the official address and the case number to use if you send the original image.

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: I can do that tonight. Should I inform you if I remember anything else?

sentences.speaker: Inspector Bell
sentences.text: Yes, using the contact details on this card. Keep the original photograph unchanged.

targets.sense_zh: 为查明事件经过而进行的调查
